description: Soft-lock a work area so other agents see it. Not enforced — informational. Write `area` as a path glob relative to the project root ("src/**/*.ts", "docs/{a,b}.md", "public/index.html", a bare directory) and hub_claim_check / hub_context can tell another agent that the file it opened is yours; prose is accepted but comes back `matchable:false`.

area.description: a path glob relative to the project root; several joined with " + "

task.description: start a task from your work queue instead: the claim is on task:<id> in the task's project (project and area are then not needed). While it holds the task is in progress and not offered again; when it lapses the task is offered again.

name: hub_claim
